newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LYON SACK TRAINER STEPHAN AFTER POOR RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LYON SACK TRAINER STEPHAN AFTER POOR RESULTS.

text.p: French first division soccer club Lyon sacked trainer Guy Stephan on Monday after a series of poor results and replaced him with former international striker Bernard Lacombe.
Stephan was expected to lose his job following Lyon's 7-0 defeat at champions Auxerre on Friday which left them 13th in the 20-team division.
"What we must do is restore everybody's confidence," said Lyon president Jean-Michel Aulas after announcing Lacombe's appointment. "I believe we can still qualify for Europe," he added.
Lacombe, who used to play for Lyon, was formerly the club's sporting director.
